tagline: Turn 3D GLB/glTF models into sprite sheets and single sprites in your browser
short_description: A browser-based 3D-to-sprite workshop for previewing turntable views and animation frames, then exporting sprite sheets or cropped single sprites.
long_description: Sprites is a static, browser-based 3D-to-sprite workshop. Select a GLB/glTF model and animation clip, preview sampled views and frames, configure camera pitch, view count, output dimensions, and background, then render and export a row-major PNG or adaptive-palette WebP sprite sheet. It also supports capturing a single angle with automatic bounds cropping, optional JSON metadata, and optional derived diagonal animation directions. The project is a companion asset-preparation tool for the Oblique 2.5D scene sandbox.
notes: Live site title is 'Model Browser · Turntable'. README describes a browser-based 3D-to-sprite workshop and links to the companion Oblique sandbox. Static site; Three.js is loaded from jsDelivr.
